title: Import Server Connection from Deploy App
breadcrumb: Import Server Connection from Deploy App

slides.title: Getting online
slides.html:
• With Deploy App, you can use 'Auto Import Connection' from Deploy App's TAK page to connect to server.
  • This connection method takes you two taps for green connection.
  • From Deploy App you can also download the client configuration package.

This guide covers only the quick way, as with ATAK & Deploy App there is no need to manually to juggle with client zips nor passwords and so on.

slides.title: 3. ATAK Auto-Import
slides.html:
• The Auto-Import button asks for opening your ATAK app and automatically importing a server configuration package to it.
  • Press Open ATAK and connect to server button to do so.

slides.title: 3. Approve loading the server config
slides.html:
• ATAK should open and ask about importing a package with a long link.
  • Tap Yes to proceed.
  • If ATAK does open but no dialog appears, try Auto-import again. It will work now.

slides.title: 4. That's it! You're online.
slides.html:
• That's it!
  • The green TAK icon in your screen indicates that you are now connected to your unit's Deploy App TAK Server.
